visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a large, bright exhibition hall with high ceilings and a grid-like metal structure overhead. A large white booth with blue branding for 'CSE' and '正成集團' is visible. A crowd of people, many holding cameras and phones, is gathered around the booth area, with some reaching up to film the display. (2) A man with dark, styled hair and wearing a black zip-up jacket over a white t-shirt walks through the exhibition hall. He speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with his hands while carrying a white paper cup. In the background, various booths for camera brands like Sony and Lowepro are visible under bright indoor lights. (3) A woman with long dark hair, wearing an oversized grey t-shirt featuring an anime character, demonstrates a smartphone camera rig. She squats down playfully and poses as if taking photos, moving with high energy. A male staff member in a blue polo shirt stands beside her, observing the demonstration on a yellow floor. (4) Extreme close-ups show a black carrying case filled with various camera lenses designed for smartphones. A hand is seen attaching a circular lens to an iPhone case. The lighting is focused and bright, highlighting the texture and branding on the lenses and the phone accessories. (5) The woman demonstrates a small circular ring light attached to the top of a smartphone. She adjusts the brightness levels, and the light reflects clearly on her face shown on the phone screen. The camera captures her reflection and the physical device from different angles, showing the mounting mechanism. (6) A man in a sharp navy blue suit and a white dress shirt joins the group. He holds a coffee cup and interacts with the woman and the man in the black jacket. They stand in front of a product display for GoPro, laughing and talking animatedly. The background remains a busy exhibition environment.
